data.body: 2026-07-31: Investigated why the Windows installer places Adashi under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Adashi. The packaged NSIS installer is using Tauri's implicit default because src-tauri/tauri.conf.json has no bundle.windows.nsis.installMode; the installed Tauri 2.11 schema defaults that setting to currentUser. The live HKCU uninstall entry confirms C:\Users\timo\AppData\Local\Adashi, and that directory currently mixes adashi.exe, adashi-mcp.exe, uninstall.exe, and settings.json. Adashi's own settings_path intentionally writes %LOCALAPPDATA%\Adashi\settings.json. Conclusion: this is an unconfigured Tauri per-user default, not an explicit Adashi packaging decision; setting NSIS installMode to perMachine would install under Program Files and restore code/data separation. No source files changed.
